jobs.description: Introduction/About usAs Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) - Customer Service & Platform, you are responsible for analyzing, shaping, documenting, and supporting the implementation of business requirements for the Customer Service and Platform stream within the global Customer Engagement ecosystem (Salesforce CRM), with a strong focus on Salesforce Service Cloud and Platform capabilities.You act as the key interface between Customer Service stakeholders, Product Owners, technical teams, and regional or local CRM specialists. The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. You translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and solution concepts and can independently implement approved no-code and low-code changes within the applicable governance framework.Your focus is on scalable, harmonized, and user-centered Customer Service and Platform solutions. You ensure that global processes can be adopted effectively across regions while enabling appropriate localization for market-specific operational and regulatory requirements. You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, customer interactions, knowledge, entitlements, service channels, automation, data quality, reporting, and related integrations.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process mapping, and refinement sessions with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; document requirements and decisions in JIRA and Confluence.Functional Solution Design and Salesforce Configuration:- Design maintainable Service Cloud and Platform solutions with Product Owners, architects, developers, integration specialists, data teams, and other platform streams, assessing standard functionality, configuration, low-code automation, integration, or custom development.- Configure approved no-code and low-code changes within governance and deployment processes, including objects and fields, layouts, Dynamic Forms, record types, Lightning pages, list views, queues, assignment and validation rules, reports, dashboards, Flow automation, and other declarative capabilities.- Create prototypes or proof-of-concept configurations and assess end-to-end impacts on processes, data, integrations, automation, reporting, permissions, mobile use, and dependent platform streams.- Ensure compliance with architecture, security, access-control, data protection, naming, documentation, and release standards; collaborate with developers for Apex, Lightning Web Components, or other coded solutions, as software development is outside the role.Customer Service Process and Platform Ownership Support- Serve as functional expert for Customer Service processes and Service Cloud, including case lifecycle, inquiries, interaction history, routing and queues, service channels, knowledge, entitlements and milestones, templates, automation, and reporting.- Drive consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems; evolve reusable global templates while enabling justified, controlled localization.- Identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the responsible evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results; provide expert functional support for complex or escalated topics and coordinate with technical teams as needed.Your qualifications- Degree in business administration, economics, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.- At least 5 years in Business Analysis, CRM, Customer Service, commercial operations, or a related field—preferably Pharma/Life Sciences—including 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud experience in a BA, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or similar role.- Expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshops, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, stakeholder alignment, agile delivery, JIRA, and Confluence.- Hands-on Salesforce declarative and low-code configuration, including Flow;
